design_metadata.transportation_concept_zh: 四层交通体系：快速路/主干路（对外衔接）— 次干路（区域联通）— 支路街区道路（街区可达）— 超级绿道（慢行优先+AI接驳无缝）。
design_metadata.transportation_concept_en: Four-tier transport system: expressways/arterials (external links), secondary roads (district links), local streets (block access), and the Super Greenway (slow-traffic priority with seamless AI shuttle).

tiers.role_zh: 对外快速集散，衔接北五环、学院路/西土城路等外围走廊
tiers.role_en: Fast external distribution via Northern 5th Ring Road and Xueyuan Lu / Xitucheng Lu corridors

tiers.role_zh: 众智·进化园—原点·共生坊—星桥·对话港三大重点区之间的区域联通
tiers.role_en: District-level links between the Evolution Park, Symbiosis Hub and Dialogue Port

tiers.role_zh: 15分钟生活圈与AI服务圈内的街区可达与慢行接驳
tiers.role_en: Block access and slow-traffic connections within the 15-minute living and AI service circles

tiers.role_zh: 慢行优先、AI接驳无缝；串联京张遗址公园主轴与清河、小月河滨水绿道
tiers.role_en: Slow-traffic priority with seamless AI shuttle, linking the Jing-Zhang Heritage Park spine with the Qinghe and Xiaoyuehe waterfront greenways

design_metadata.super_greenway_zh: 以京张遗址公园为脊柱的超级绿道系统：机动车减速让行，绿道连续无断点，AI无人接驳车沿绿道运营，实现“在公园里通勤”的绿色体验。
design_metadata.super_greenway_en: The Super Greenway system takes the Jing-Zhang Heritage Park as its spine: traffic-calmed streets, a gap-free greenway, and AI shuttle pods running along the corridor — 'commuting inside a park'.
design_metadata.note_zh: 道路线位为设计概念示意，不代表道路红线或规划线位。

properties.design_role_zh: 原点·共生坊与京张主轴绿廊之间的超级绿道横段，AI接驳优先
properties.design_role_en: Transverse Super Greenway link across the Symbiosis Hub with AI shuttle priority

properties.design_role_zh: 沿京张遗址公园的南北向绿道主轴，连接三大重点区
properties.design_role_en: North-south greenway spine along the Jing-Zhang Heritage Park linking all three key districts

properties.name_zh: 主干路·东侧南北贯通线
properties.design_role_zh: 东侧南北贯通的对外集散主干线（示意线位）
properties.design_role_en: Eastern north-south arterial spine for external distribution (illustrative alignment)

properties.name_zh: 次干路·南段东西联络线
properties.design_role_zh: 星桥·对话港与南段街区的东西向区域联通线
properties.design_role_en: East-west district link serving the Dialogue Port and southern blocks

properties.design_role_zh: 众智·进化园南缘与中段街区的支路连接线（示意）
properties.design_role_en: Local connector at the southern edge of the Evolution Park (illustrative)
